c1-jas-0008: James pictures two visitors coming into the assembly, one poor and one finely dressed. Let's read James 2:2 together.
c2-jas-0002: James speaks to people making plans to travel to a city and do business. Let's read James 4:14.
c2-jas-0003: James describes the well-dressed visitor being given a good place. Let's read James 2:3-4.
c2-jas-0004: James speaks of laborers whose wages were kept back by fraud. Let's read James 5:3-4.
c3-jas-0001: James asks whether anyone among them is sick. Let's read James 5:13-14 together.
c3-jas-0002: James speaks about the poor of this world and God's kingdom. Let's read James 2:5 and 5:1.
c3-jas-0003: James invites believers to draw near to God. Let's read James 4:8 and 5:16.
c3-jas-0004: James talks about knowing the good we ought to do. Let's read James 2:10 and 4:17.
c1-1pe-0002: Peter encourages the elders to shepherd the flock among them. Let's read First Peter 5:4.
c2-1pe-0006: Peter encourages believers to be hospitable to one another. Let's read First Peter 4:9 together.
c2-1pe-0007: Peter writes about different reasons a person might suffer. Let's read First Peter 4:15-16.
c2-1pe-0008: Peter gives the elders guidance about caring for God's flock. Let's read First Peter 5:2-3.
c3-1pe-0003: Peter speaks of governors sent to punish evildoers and praise those who do good. Let's read First Peter 2:14-15.
c3-1pe-0004: Peter calls believers bondservants of God. Let's read First Peter 2:16 and 4:10.
c3-1pe-0005: Peter writes about people who speak against a believer's good conduct. Let's read First Peter 2:12 and 3:16.
c3-1pe-0006: Peter writes to elders and to all believers about how to live. Let's read First Peter 3:13 and 5:3.
c1-1jn-0002: John writes tenderly to his little children with a word of warning. Let's read First John 2:18.
c2-1jn-0006: John says the anointing believers received from Him abides in them. Let's read First John 2:27.
c2-1jn-0007: John writes about some who went out from among the believers. Let's read First John 2:19 and 2:26.
c2-1jn-0008: John speaks gently about a heart that condemns us. Let's read First John 3:20-21.
c3-1jn-0003: John says believers ought to lay down their lives for the brethren. Let's read First John 3:16-17.
c3-1jn-0004: John reminds us that we have an Advocate with the Father. Let's read First John 2:1 and 3:8.
c3-1jn-0005: John reminds the little children that they are of God. Let's read First John 2:22 and 4:4.
c3-1jn-0006: John says we know He abides in us by the Spirit He has given us. Let's read First John 3:24 and 4:6.
c1-eph-0007: Paul urges believers not to grieve the Holy Spirit of God. Let's read Ephesians 4:30.
c2-eph-0001: Paul speaks to the Ephesians as dear children. Let's read Ephesians 5:1 together.
c2-eph-0002: Paul tells believers to put away lying and speak truth with a neighbor. Let's read Ephesians 4:25-26.
c2-eph-0003: Paul warns about the wrath that comes upon the sons of disobedience. Let's read Ephesians 5:6-7.
c3-eph-0002: Paul encourages believers to speak to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs. Let's read Ephesians 5:19-20.
c3-eph-0003: Paul says Christ loved the church and gave Himself for her. Let's read Ephesians 5:2 and 5:25.
c3-eph-0004: Paul writes about putting on the new man. Let's read Ephesians 4:24 and 5:27 together.
c3-eph-0005: Paul gives fathers wise counsel about their children. Let's read Ephesians 4:31 and 6:4.
c1-jud-0001: Jude opens by calling himself a bondservant of Jesus Christ. Let's read Jude 1:1.
c2-jud-0001: Jude says Enoch prophesied about these men. Let's read Jude 1:14 together.
c2-jud-0002: Jude speaks of men who ran greedily in the error of Balaam. Let's read Jude 1:11 and 1:16.
c2-jud-0003: Jude warns about people who cause divisions. Let's read Jude 1:18-19.
c3-jud-0001: Jude reminds the beloved that mockers would come in the last time. Let's read Jude 1:17-18.
c3-jud-0002: Jude tells believers to keep themselves while looking for mercy. Let's read Jude 1:21 and 1:24.
c3-jud-0003: Jude urges his readers to contend earnestly. Let's read Jude 1:3 and 1:15.
c3-jud-0004: Jude prays that mercy, peace, and love would be multiplied. Let's read Jude 1:2 and 1:20.
